title: 12 Best Soak in Reykjavik's heated outdoor geothermal pools and the scenic Sky Lagoon on the harbor.
description: Discover Reykjavik's best geothermal pools and lagoons. From the luxurious Sky Lagoon to local public baths and the iconic Blue Lagoon, find your perfect soak in Iceland's heated waters. Your guide to relaxation and wellness.

places.name: Sky Lagoon
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Pure' or 'Sky' Ritual package for the full seven-step experience, which includes a cold plunge, sauna, mist, and invigorating body scrub.

places.name: Blue Lagoon
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Comfort Package includes entry, a silica mud mask, a towel, and one drink. Upgrade for more amenities if you desire a longer, more indulgent visit.

places.name: Laugardalslaug
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Simply purchase an entry ticket; all hot tubs and facilities are included. Grab a hot dog from the snack stand afterwards for the full local experience.

places.name: Sundhöllin
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Entry ticket. Make sure to find the rooftop hot tub for great views over the city, especially in winter or at dusk.

places.name: Vesturbæjarlaug
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Just your entry. Spend time rotating between the different hot tubs; each has its own regular crowd and conversations.

places.name: Secret Lagoon (Gamla Laugin)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Entry ticket. Bring your own towel and swimwear to save on rental fees.

places.name: Arbæjarlaug
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Entry ticket. Prepare for fun on the slides!

places.name: Grafarvogslaug
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Standard entry. Don't miss testing out all the different slides if you're feeling adventurous.

places.name: Kópavogslaug
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Entry ticket. Seek out the highest hot tub for the best panoramic views.

places.name: Seltjarnarneslaug
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Just your entrance fee. Enjoy the tranquil atmosphere.

places.name: Fontana Geothermal Bath
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Entry to the baths, and don't miss trying their traditional rye bread, baked underground using the geothermal heat, often served with butter.

places.name: Kvika Footbath
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Nothing, it's completely free! Just bring yourself and enjoy the view.
